tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. New original reusable children's educational character sprite sheet, based directly on the attached adopted identity reference. Reference is an identity/style reference, not an edit target.
Subject: Amami Rabbit (アマミノクロウサギ). Draw this exact same individual, with precisely the same warm brown contour, soft painted paper texture, body colours and markings, large white eye shapes and brown pupils WITHOUT white highlights, big head, short round torso and limbs. Preserve all distinctive ears, nose, muzzle, tail and limb counts. Keep its established lightly anthropomorphic upright bipedal character design. No clothing or props.
Composition: a high-resolution 3072x3072 square transparent RGBA PNG, evenly divided conceptually into 3 columns and 3 rows, no visible grid, no cell borders, no text or numbers. Nine isolated full-body drawings, one per equal cell, row-major. All nine have the same anatomical head and torso scale and short standing proportions. Fill each cell with a comfortably large complete figure with clear transparent margin; no touching or crossing a cell boundary. Use a single consistent camera angle and warm outline thickness. Never resize a crouching/tilting pose to fill its box. Do not mirror any markings or tail.
POSE ORDER:
Top-left blink: same standing body position, head proportions and vertical head/torso/foot distances as the reference, change ONLY eyes to gentle closed curved lines, relaxed smile. Do not shorten torso or lower head.
Top-middle greet: gentle clear greeting, raise just one existing arm to the side, other arm relaxed, feet grounded.
Top-right present_left: one existing arm opens toward viewer-left, eyes look toward viewer-left, body mostly front-facing.
Middle-left present_right: one existing arm opens toward viewer-right, eyes look toward viewer-right, preserve true side-specific tail and markings; not a mirrored duplicate.
Middle-middle think: gentle pondering, one paw near cheek, head only subtly tilted, retain muzzle and eye design.
Middle-right aha: gentle discovery, cheerful open eyes and one small raised forepaw, mouth small, no symbols.
Bottom-left cheer: both existing forepaws lifted in a mild happy celebration, both feet still planted, no floating duplicate feet.
Bottom-middle species_a: A tiny attentive head tilt with the existing ears angling slightly outward; torso, forepaws and planted feet remain stable.
Bottom-right species_b: Head begins to return and the existing ears settle slightly forward, without changing their reference length or shape.
Constraints: genuine transparent background with generated alpha; exactly one same character per cell; no text, labels, decorations, shadows, ground, motion lines, watermarks or external effects. Crisp native contours and smooth intentional watercolor surfaces, no muddy colour lumps, bleeding paint or duplicated/disconnected body parts. Keep open eyes identical to the reference, no sparkle dots, no extra toes, fingers or limbs. This is freshly drawn expression/gesture art, not a different redesign.
